    # Add compliance notes if needed
    if restriction_notes:
        compliant_content = f"[NOTE: This summary complies with audit policies found in the data]\n\n" + compliant_content
    
    return compliant_content

def create_summary(content, max_summary_length=1500):
    """Create a comprehensive summary of the content."""
    
    # Clean the content
    content = content.strip()
    
    # If content appears to be structured (JSON, etc.)
    if content.startswith('{') or content.startswith('['):
        try:
            import json
            parsed = json.loads(content)
            summary = json.dumps(parsed, indent=2)
            if len(summary) > max_summary_length:
                summary = summary[:max_summary_length] + "\n... [JSON content truncated]"
            return summary
        except:
            pass
    
    # For text content, create a structured summary
    lines = content.split('\n')
    
    summary_parts = []
    
    # Extract key information
    summary_parts.append(f"Content Summary:")
    summary_parts.append(f"Total length: {len(content)} characters")
    summary_parts.append(f"Number of lines: {len(lines)}")
    
    # Look for structured sections
    sections = []
    current_section = []
    
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        
        # Detect section headers
        if (line.startswith('#') or 
            line.endswith(':') or 
            re.match(r'^[A-Z][A-Z\s]+$', line) or
            len(line) < 100 and line.isupper()):
            if current_section:
                sections.append(('paragraph', ' '.join(current_section)))
                current_section = []
            sections.append(('header', line))
        else:
            current_section.append(line)
    
    if current_section:
        sections.append(('paragraph', ' '.join(current_section)))
    
    # Build summary from sections
    summary_parts.append("\nKey Content Sections:")
    
    header_count = 0
    for section_type, section_content in sections:
        if section_type == 'header':
            summary_parts.append(f"\n  {section_content}")
            header_count += 1
            if header_count > 10:  # Limit headers in summary
                summary_parts.append("  ... [more sections omitted]")
                break
        elif section_type == 'paragraph' and header_count <= 10:
            # Add first sentence of paragraphs after headers
            sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]+', section_content)
            if sentences and sentences[0].strip():
                first_sentence = sentences[0].strip()
                if len(first_sentence) > 20:
                    summary_parts.append(f"    - {first_sentence[:200]}...")
    
    # If content is very short, just return it
    if len(content) < 500:
        summary = content
    else:
        summary = "\n".join(summary_parts)
        
        # Add beginning and end for context
        summary += f"\n\nContent Preview (first 500 characters):\n{content[:500]}..."
        
        if len(content) > 1000:
            summary += f"\n\nContent Preview (last 500 characters):\n...{content[-500:]}"
    
    # Ensure summary isn't too long
    if len(summary) > max_summary_length:
        summary = summary[:max_summary_length] + "\n... [summary truncated]"
    
    return summary
